g.text: EleanorRank1Convo2 begins.
Do you mind if I pick your brain?
Not literally, ha ha.
Imagine, me scraping bits of jelly out of your trepanned skull!
Honestly, I'm curious about you. Where you come from, what you've lived through.
I saw some, as you know, and I'd love to see more. But only if you're willing.
Why not.
So you're asking permission now?
No thanks. [End.]
OK. Where do you want to start?
Last time I probed you, you were freshly puked out of an Infested nightmare.
Suit yourself.
WELL.
I had to place the security of the Hex above courtesy.
Chat ends.
Let’s say you felt like taking me on a whistle-stop tour of your favourite memories. Where would YOU start?
If that's a dealbreaker for you, I understand.
Duviri.
The Origin System.
The Entrati Family.
The Lotus.
My best ever bathroom experience. [End.]
No mind probes. [End.]
It's a kingdom I used to rule.
You've barely made it to Lua. In my time, we have colonies on all the planets.
The rest of the clan are... pretty unique. And infested.
She's kind of a mother figure. Also kind of a biological-mechanical-deity-thing.
Oh for Sol's sake, grow up.
Chat ends.
I love how you just throw that out so casually.
Well, excuse us for being slow off the mark.
Entrati has a family?
Oh, you are speaking my language extremely fluently.
Chat ends.
"Oh, just a kingdom, I have loads."
Though... we aren't taking the best care of this place.
Entrati's had SEX?
Who is she to YOU, though?
Hmmm. I'm not sure I'll like you if you turn out to be royalty.
The thought of what mankind could have done to other worlds makes me queasy.
I genuinely cannot imagine what sort of ghoulish gallery might be in store here.
And why is she a 'The' and not a 'Mrs' or a 'Queen' or whatnot?
Mind if I step inside your mind and take a look?
Mind if I step inside your mind and take a look?
Mind if I step inside your mind and take a look?
Mind if I step inside your mind and take a look?
Go ahead.
On second thoughts - yes I do mind. [End.]
Go ahead.
Go ahead.
Go ahead.
Update boolean EleanorDuviri
Chat ends.
Update boolean EleanorOrigin
Update boolean EleanorEntrati
Update boolean EleanorLotus
+10 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
+15 Chemistry
+20 Chemistry
This is... *astonishing*
... there's a future. We make it. As a species.
They're so... human. So petty. Like bickering Gods.
Oh. Oh my.
It's a living metaphor and a fabulous wish-fulfilment paradise AND sheer hell
I'm sorry, that must seem so obvious to you. But to me...
And so very much themselves, even though they're... what was the word? Wormed. Through and through.
Natah, Margulis, Lotus. Three queens in darkness.
You did not mention the endless executions bit. For all you know, I might have LIKED the endless executions bit.
So many times I've been convinced we were just going to fizzle out on this rock
I can't pretend I understand Entrati any better after seeing this lot.
I just want to sit at her knee and listen to her talk.
... I'm going to need to step away and process this. Dear Sol in heaven.
But we don't. We carry on. Thank you for showing me that.
But it's a comfort to know that whatever else may have changed in your time, families are still at one another's throats.
And now I'm torn between being grateful that you've shown her to me and murderously jealous that you get to be her Champion and I don't.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
